misc.sum: Rohit Sharma returned to the helm on Friday , with Mumbai Indians appointing the Hitman as the team’s captain heading into the 2027 season. Rohit was reappointed as MI skipper for the first time in 3 years, after he was removed as captain in favour of Hardik Pandya back in 2023.
pts: Rohit had first taken over as Mumbai captain midway through what was at that point a disastrous IPL campaign in 2013.
Rohit has led in 158 matches in the IPL, winning 87, only bettered by MS Dhoni, who recently called time on his IPL career.
Rohit last led in T20 cricket during India’s victorious run to the T20 World Cup in the West Indies in 2024.
